verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only that Proton Pass generates standard TOTP codes for saved logins. Nothing in the pack covers Steam Guard codes, HOTP counter-based tokens, or custom periods and digit lengths. The axis clearly applies to a password manager with a built-in authenticator, so the lack of evidence makes this 'none' rather than 'na'.

support.subject: As a power user, non-standard tokens work too — Steam Guard, HOTP counters, custom periods and digit lengths
